content.short: Sender is a blockchain software development company.
content.description: Sender makes it simple to buy cryptocurrency from trusted global providers, move coins from other exchanges or wallets into your own wallet, and send crypto to anyone no matter where they are. It also supports receiving payments directly into your wallet when others send crypto, lets you convert assets via decentralized exchanges (DEX), and keeps you informed about price trends, leading tokens, and assets that are gaining attention.
content.meta: Sender enables crypto purchases, transfers from other wallets into your wallet and swaps via DEXs. Discover Sender and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
